Manual black bars extend beyond the Expiry field into CVC area

defects.problem: Cursor overlaps the 'StreamFlix' wordmark and the lock icons are too small to read at 1080p

defects.problem: 'A made-up billing screen' label and the VO line say the same thing twice, plus a third tiny provenance line

oneLineVerdict: Clear, honest, well paced reveal of partial detection; small icons and sparse lower right keep it shy of 8.5.
